content:
aline_cs: Quick sync 1 Spark preview cohort kickoff in 4 days. Need final enrollments + 1-line use case + single top risk per account by Tue EOD. Put details in https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/spark-enroll (please do not change header row).

derrick_csm: Uploading my list now. Two customers need SSO, one asked for IP allowlist and retention=14d.

pilar_enable: I can run a 20-min admin slot during kickoff to capture IdP metadata and show the retention toggle. Can someone collect preferred trace windows?

sam_eng: Token-level traces: recommend 12h windows only. If customers request >24h we need billing sign-off. Also ask customers for 3 canonical prompts (short, typical, edge) for evals.

infra_jude: For IP allowlist we need CIDR + expected RPS. If sustained RPS >60 we'll advise reserved capacity. Also exports go to s3://redwood-spark-traces.

aline_cs: Adding cols to the sheet now: success_metric, trial_blocker, sso_ready, trace_window, prompts_needed, ok_to_share_sanitized_notes. Fill by Tue EOD.

derrick_csm: Marked one account as procurement_pending under trial_blocker and added an action: schedule exec sync.

pilar_enable: I'll draft Day7 3-question survey and Day14 interview guide and drop in the enablement drive by Fri.

sam_eng: I'll prepare the eval harness and a tiny runbook to pull traces when windows are enabled.

infra_jude: Reminder: if multiple accounts request tracing simultaneously it could spike storage costs. CS please stagger windows where possible.

aline_cs: Good note. We'll ask customers to pick preferred 12h windows during first 48h and try to avoid overlap. Derrick, capture windows in the sheet.

derrick_csm: Will do. Also adding a "close_loop" column to track blocker resolution.

notify-bot: Reminder set: "Spark enroll list due" on Tue 17:00 UTC.

aline_cs: Rollout checklist (compact):
- Confirm enroll list (CS)
- Capture IdP metadata + CIDR + RPS + prompts (CS)
- Assign trace windows (CS + Infra)
- Enablement admin slot + survey (Enablement)
- Eval harness ready + trace export runbook (Eng)
- Risk flags + mitigation + billing sign-off if >24h traces (CS/Billing)

alin e_cs: Thanks all. If you own an action, update the sheet row as you complete it. DM me for blockers.
